baseline_observations: index-START.html script block is empty, meaning key presses produce no sound, no animations, and no feedback.
No error handling exists if an audio asset fails to load or play; browser audio.play() rejections would go unhandled.
No feedback or empty state message is presented when an unmapped key or empty interaction occurs.
No CSS fallback background color was defined if background.jpg asset fails to load.
decision: Implement drum kit audio triggering with try/catch and audio.play().catch() error boundary; add #status-display for unmapped input and audio asset error states; add CSS error/fallback states; add automated Playwright regression test tests/course/r57-t032.mjs verifying error states, route abort fixture, and clean recovery.
